lanes.name: Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: Ticket, queue, assignment, audit and activity records

lanes.name: SLA & Escalation Engine
lanes.hint: SLA monitoring, RAG status, escalation routing

lanes.name: Notification
lanes.hint: SMS, email, WhatsApp, push, distribution lists

nodes.label: Agent Login & Credential Validation
nodes.desc: The agent logs in using Agent ID and password; the system validates the Agent ID and credentials before granting access.

nodes.label: Role-Based Access & Dashboard
nodes.desc: After login the agent sees role-scoped view/edit options, Agent 360, and a dashboard displaying only the tickets and tasks assigned to that agent (reuses Agent 360 BRSD requirements).

nodes.label: Validate Q Ticket & Identify Customer
nodes.desc: The agent validates the Q Ticket and identifies the customer before initiating a Trouble Ticket. Note: this requirement ID duplicates TT-001-JSM-01 used under §1 Agent Login in the source register — carried forward as-is, not renumbered.

nodes.label: Customer Identification
nodes.desc: Customer identification is completed before the agent initiates the Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Verify Customer via IDWise Scan
nodes.desc: The Retail Agent verifies the customer by scanning the ID document through IDWise, before initiating a Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Verify Customer via Verification Question
nodes.desc: Telesales or Retail agents verify the customer by asking a verification question, before initiating a Trouble Ticket.

nodes.label: Navigate to Customer 360
nodes.desc: The agent navigates to Customer 360 before initiating the ticket (reuses Customer 360 BRSD requirements). A Trouble Ticket may only be created once verified Customer, Service Account and Billing Account context exists.

nodes.label: Smart Search for Categorisation
nodes.desc: The agent searches by keyword (minimum three characters, P-01) to identify the applicable ticket category before raising a ticket; ranked suggestions come from the Knowledge Base and historical tickets.

nodes.label: Create Manual Trouble Ticket
nodes.desc: The system creates a ticket automatically with a unique Ticket ID for the selected Service Request, Trouble Ticket or Query category when the agent raises it manually.

nodes.label: Automatic Ticket on Order Failure
nodes.desc: A Trouble Ticket is created automatically when an AIA order creation request fails; the error reason is recorded in the Description field and the error code is returned to AIA. Integration: INT-TT-02 (OSM/AIA, synchronous SOAP over OSB, CreateTroubleTicket operation).

nodes.label: Auto-Populated Fields
nodes.desc: Fields designated for automatic population use the approved source of record; override is permitted only by an authorised role. Integration: INT-TT-10 (UIM, retrieves service and inventory information for ticket enrichment; ticket creation proceeds without enrichment on failure).

nodes.label: Manually Filled Fields
nodes.desc: The agent enters the fields designated as manually filled; the creating agent is accountable for their completeness and accuracy.

nodes.label: Knowledge Base Access from Ticket
nodes.desc: Selecting the knowledge base button opens the Knowledge Base in another tab; categorisation and handling guidance must use current, approved content. Integration: INT-TT-11 (Knowledge Base, bi-directional REST, searchArticles operation).

nodes.label: Categorise: Source / TT Type / Area / Sub-Area
nodes.desc: The agent selects Source, Category, Area and Sub Area by keyword search and Knowledge Base reference; the Sub Area picklist is dynamically filtered to only mapped, valid values for the selected Area.

nodes.label: Select Description Template
nodes.desc: The agent selects the correct description template from the Knowledge Base and updates the ticket description; the template must be active, approved and applicable to the selected classification. Integration: INT-TT-11 (Knowledge Base, description template retrieval).

nodes.label: Description Template Administration
nodes.desc: A user holding the Template Administration privilege may create, amend and retire description templates.

nodes.label: Save Ticket Details
nodes.desc: The ticket is saved once all mandatory fields are populated.

nodes.label: Pass Ticket Details Downstream
nodes.desc: Integrations: INT-TT-03 (Kafka/ODS/Channels, publishes TroubleTicketStatusChangeEvent) and INT-TT-04 (Downstream Systems, asynchronous real-time Trouble Ticket updates).

nodes.label: Auto-Assign to Creator
nodes.desc: The newly created ticket is automatically assigned to the agent who created it.

nodes.label: Priority Derivation from Customer Type
nodes.desc: Ticket Priority (P-03: 1-ASAP, 2-High, 3-Medium, 4-Low) is derived from the Customer Type matrix at creation and cannot be overridden by a non-privileged user.

nodes.label: Auto-Assign to Queue
nodes.desc: The ticket is assigned to the appropriate queue using the predefined combination of Source, TT Category, Area, Sub Area, Language, Customer Type and TT Queue, assuming agents in that queue hold the appropriate privileges.

nodes.label: Generic Queue Fallback
nodes.desc: A ticket whose auto-assignment parameters match no predefined combination is assigned to the Generic Queue.

nodes.label: View Queue-Assigned Tickets
nodes.desc: The agent views tickets assigned to the applicable queue, including generic and auto-assigned queues.

nodes.label: Supervisor Cross-Queue Reassignment
nodes.desc: An agent acting as supervisor reassigns the Trouble Ticket to a different queue.

nodes.label: Bulk Selection & Assignment
nodes.desc: The agent selects multiple or all filtered tickets and bulk-assigns them to one target queue in a single action, permitted only in accordance with agent privileges.

nodes.label: Status/Sub-Status Set to Assigned
nodes.desc: Status and Sub-Status change to 'Assigned' when a ticket is allocated to a named user or queue, including a supervisor-assigned ticket received by the agent; recorded in the audit trail.

nodes.label: Assignment Email Notification
nodes.desc: The agent receives an email after a Trouble Ticket is assigned. Integration: INT-TT-07 (Enterprise SMTP Relay, assignment email notification).

nodes.label: Assignment Rejection
nodes.desc: The agent rejects an assigned ticket, setting Sub-Status to 'Rejected' and making it available for reallocation, with the reason recorded in the audit trail; reassignment among team members is not permitted.

nodes.label: Manual Parent-Child Association
nodes.desc: The agent manually associates related tickets as child of a master ticket; tickets matching TT Category, MSISDN, Area and Sub Area may be marked associated.

nodes.label: Duplicate Ticket Association
nodes.desc: The agent manually associates duplicate Trouble Tickets; tickets matching TT Category, MSISDN, Area and Sub Area may be marked as duplicate.

nodes.label: Scan-to-Attach (Retail)
nodes.desc: A Retail Agent scans a physical document and attaches it to the ticket; the scan control is not displayed to any other role.

nodes.label: Manual File Attachment
nodes.desc: The agent attaches files while the ticket is in any non-terminal status; the system enforces a maximum file size, permitted file-type whitelist and maximum attachment count, and malware-scans every file before storage. Size, type-whitelist and count constraints are configurable: P-13 (max file size), P-14 (permitted file types), P-15 (max attachments per ticket) — all three values marked To be confirmed in the source.

nodes.label: Attachment View & Download
nodes.desc: A permitted user views and downloads attachments at any ticket status, including terminal ones; each access is recorded in the audit trail.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Capture
nodes.desc: Every Status change, Sub-Status change, field change, assignment change, attachment action and notification dispatch is recorded immutably with actor, UTC timestamp, before value and after value.

nodes.label: Audit Trail Access
nodes.desc: A permitted user views the audit trail chronologically from the detailed ticket view; records cannot be edited or deleted.

nodes.label: Access Event Logging
nodes.desc: Ticket access events log user identity, IP address, geo-location where available, and access channel, retained per the approved retention policy.

nodes.label: Create Manual Activity
nodes.desc: The agent adds an activity manually under the Trouble Ticket, identifying its business purpose and responsible agent.

nodes.label: View Ticket Activities
nodes.desc: Manual and system-generated activities are visible under the ticket with their origin, viewable only by users authorised for the parent ticket.

nodes.label: Automatic Activity at Trigger Points
nodes.desc: An activity is created automatically at business trigger points approved by the process owner.

nodes.label: Close Open Activity
nodes.desc: The agent closes activities that are not closed automatically; an open activity may be closed only by its owner or another role authorised for that activity type.

nodes.label: Close All Activities on Ticket Closure
AI-Assisted Triage
nodes.desc: An AI-assisted journey contextualises the reported issue, pre-populates ticket fields, and proposes TT Type, Area, Sub-Area, Priority and routing; the agent may accept or override each proposal. Positioned under Activity Execution in the source register, though its content concerns ticket creation/triage.

nodes.label: B2B & Enterprise Ticket Support
nodes.desc: Trouble Tickets against B2B/enterprise accounts capture account-hierarchy context and apply the enterprise Customer Type SLA matrix.

nodes.label: Automatic SMS at Defined Events
nodes.desc: A preconfigured SMS (P-02 languages: English, Arabic, Hindi, Malayalam) sends at defined events, triggered by the combination of TT Source, Category, Area, Sub Area and Queue, in the customer's preferred account language. Integration: INT-TT-05 (SMS Gateway, REST or SOAP via OSB, sendSMS operation).

nodes.label: Send Manual SMS
nodes.desc: The agent sends a manual SMS to an approved customer contact number, in line with the customer's contact permissions.

nodes.label: Search & Filter SMS Template
nodes.desc: Templates are searched by Keyword, TT Source, Category, Area, Sub Area and Status, filtered in sequence Number, Service Type, Language, Keyword; language choice covers Hindi, English, Malayalam and Arabic.

nodes.label: Select SMS Template
nodes.desc: Only active, approved templates applicable to the ticket may be selected.

nodes.label: Edit SMS Content by Role
nodes.desc: MSISDN, Language and text are editable per agent role: Frontline cannot edit text, Back Office can.

nodes.label: WhatsApp & Push Notification Channels
nodes.desc: WhatsApp and mobile app push are supported as additional customer notification channels, selectable by template and consented contact preference. Integration: INT-TT-06 (WhatsApp Business Platform, sendMessage operation; fallback to SMS on failure).

nodes.label: SLA Breach → Auto-Escalate
nodes.desc: The ticket is automatically escalated and Status changes to 'Escalate' when the applicable SLA threshold in the Customer Type matrix (BR-015 status: Open) is breached. SLA target: P-10 (non-Expatriate: 24h), P-11 (Expatriate: 48h).

nodes.label: SLA Breach Notification
nodes.desc: Reuses the TT-001-ESC-02 requirement as stated in the source; text is a direct self-reference with no further detail given. Notification tiers per P-04 (first, non-Expatriate: 12h), P-05 (first, Expatriate: 24h), P-06 (second, non-Expatriate: 24h), P-07 (second, Expatriate: 48h), P-08 (third, non-Expatriate: 72h), P-09 (third, Expatriate: 5 days).

nodes.label: RAG Status Update
nodes.desc: RAG status is updated per the SLA matrix: Green within target (P-16), Amber past first notification threshold (P-17), Red on target breach (P-18).

nodes.label: SLA Notification as Siebel Activity
nodes.desc: Each SLA notification issued creates an associated Siebel Activity record containing the ticket reference, notification tier and issue timestamp.

nodes.label: Manual Escalation with Reason
nodes.desc: The agent escalates a ticket manually by selecting a mandatory escalation reason from a controlled list; a submission without a reason is rejected.

nodes.label: Escalation Email to Distribution Lists
nodes.desc: An email is sent to every distribution list mapped to the assigned queue on escalation. Note: Priority is Must but Change Category is marked Out of Scope in the source — an apparent internal inconsistency, carried forward as stated rather than resolved. Integration: INT-TT-07 (Enterprise SMTP Relay, escalation email notification).

nodes.label: Hierarchical Escalation Notification
nodes.desc: The next higher position in the Siebel position hierarchy relative to the ticket owner is identified and notified; where none exists, the assigned queue distribution list is notified instead.

nodes.label: Distribution List Administration
nodes.desc: A user holding the Distribution List Administration privilege adds, amends and removes distribution lists mapped to a queue.

nodes.label: Escalation Dashboard
nodes.desc: The agent views escalated tickets via 'escalated to me' and 'rejected by me' filters in a separate dashboard.

nodes.label: Mandatory Fields Gate on Solved
nodes.desc: Transition to Status 'Solved' succeeds only once Resolution Code, Hashtag and TT Actual Issue are populated; otherwise the missing fields are identified to the agent.

nodes.label: Resolution Code Selection
nodes.desc: Exactly one Resolution Code is retained per ticket; selecting a different value replaces the existing one.

nodes.label: Hashtag Capture & Administration
nodes.desc: One or more Hashtags are selected from a picklist filtered by TT Type, Area and Sub-Area; a Reference Data Administration privilege holder adds and retires Hashtag values.

nodes.label: Actual Issue Capture & Administration
nodes.desc: TT Actual Issue is selected from a picklist filtered by the chosen description template; a Reference Data Administration privilege holder adds and retires values.

nodes.label: L3 Referral Reference Capture
nodes.desc: An external L3 ticket reference is recorded in a dedicated validated field while the ticket remains in Status 'Not Solved'; it is searchable and does not itself change Status. Integration: INT-TT-12 (External L3 Systems, manual reference capture only, no automated interface).

nodes.label: Automatic Resolution — Port-Out Verification
nodes.desc: Port-Out verification tickets are resolved automatically; a back-office agent may set Status to 'Solved' manually when the automated process fails, with the response sent to the MNP gateway.

nodes.label: Ticket Closure
nodes.desc: The agent sets ticket Status to 'Closed'; the system closes all associated activities using the same timestamp.

nodes.label: Ticket Reopen
nodes.desc: A Reopen privilege holder returns a ticket from 'Closed' to 'Not Solved' within the configured reopen window (P-12, value to be confirmed) with a mandatory reason; an attempt outside the window is rejected with guidance to raise a linked ticket.

nodes.label: Ticket Cancellation
nodes.desc: A Cancellation privilege holder sets ticket Status to 'Cancelled' with a mandatory reason code; the ticket is excluded from performance reporting. Terminal.

nodes.label: Trigger Customer Satisfaction Survey
nodes.desc: A feedback survey trigger is sent to Medallia only when the Trouble Ticket reaches Resolved status. Integration: INT-TT-08 (Medallia/Survey Platform, triggerSurvey operation).

nodes.label: CSAT Response Attribution
nodes.desc: The survey response is stored against the originating ticket and made visible in the ticket view and in reporting. Integration: INT-TT-09 (Medallia/Survey Platform, postSurveyResponse operation, inbound).

nodes.label: Ticket List View with Filters
nodes.desc: Tickets are viewed in a list filtered by field set FS-09 criteria; filters can be saved and reapplied. Note: this Req ID duplicates TT-001-VEW-01 used earlier under §9 Activity Execution in the source register — a different requirement, same identifier.

nodes.label: Standard Siebel Ticket Views
nodes.desc: My Trouble Tickets, My Team's Trouble Tickets and All Trouble Tickets views are provided, per DE_079. Integration: INT-TT-13 (ODS/Analytics Platform, Trouble Ticket reporting).

nodes.label: Queue-Restricted Ticket Views
nodes.desc: Tickets assigned to the Back Office Queue and Credit Control/Collection Queue are restricted to members of the applicable queue.

nodes.label: Customer 360 Ticket Panel
nodes.desc: All Trouble Tickets raised against a customer account are viewable from Customer 360, without restriction on ticket age. Integration: INT-TT-13 (ODS/Analytics Platform, Kafka/GoldenGate event replication for Customer 360 visibility).

nodes.label: RAG Status Indicator in List Views
nodes.desc: A Red, Amber or Green indicator is displayed per ticket in list views, derived from elapsed time against the applicable Customer Type SLA target.

nodes.label: Trouble Ticket Lifecycle Complete
nodes.desc: Terminal.

nodes.label: Create Ticket from Digital Channel
nodes.desc: A Trouble Ticket is created inbound from Web, Mobile App or Chatbot channels via the DXP createTroubleTicket interface (REST/JSON, TMF621). Fallback on interface failure is manual ticket creation by an agent.
